semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Versioned semantic rule describing nature, direction, calculation basis, family and transaction applicability independently from a numeric rate.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics formulas and Oracle rule types separate determination behavior from transaction data.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: A country rule must compose published behavior primitives; a new primitive requires architecture and PO review.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Tenant tax instance containing rate, validity, behavior version, thresholds, caps and fixed-per-unit data.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Enterprise engines version tax codes and apply them through determination configuration.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Rates and thresholds are effective-dated data; embedding them in calculation code is blocked.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Ordered resolution from transaction facts through jurisdiction, nexus, applicability, fiscal position, rate, treatment, basis and calculation into tax legs.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Oracle exposes explicit determination stages; Dynamics exposes applicability matrices and formulas.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Flat family dedup cannot represent precedence or tax-on-tax alone; complex rules require an explicit governed sequence.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Effective rule that maps or removes taxes and account roles based on party, registration, geography and transaction context.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Odoo fiscal positions map taxes and accounts and can apply automatically by country, partner and priority.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Substitution must preserve provenance and coordinate Tax with Ledger account roles.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Explainable calculation result carrying amount, base, behavior, treatment, direction, timing, account role, tags and policy provenance.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Odoo repartition and tax grids connect calculation results to accounting and statutory reporting.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: A leg without treatment, accounting role or reporting provenance cannot support country-agnostic posting and reporting.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Immutable published tax resource set with version, effective date, hash, dependencies and migration inside a Country Pack.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics publishes tax feature versions; SAP and Oracle govern reusable tax configuration content.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Opening or reforming a country changes Control Plane resources; core code changes only for a universal primitive.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Statutory aggregation driven by tax tags and declarative report lines over immutable transaction and journal provenance.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Odoo tax grids feed country tax reports; hardcoded national report services do not scale.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: A new national form is Country Pack data unless it requires a new universal rendering primitive.

northStar.bestVersion: A country-agnostic tax authority that converts frozen transaction facts and published policy into explainable tax legs for calculation, accounting, settlement and statutory reporting across every UBP process and organization.
businessOutcomes: Open an ordinary country or tax reform through a versioned Control Plane publication without recompiling the engine.
Calculate the same transaction consistently across AR AP POS Inventory transfers payments and intercompany flows.
Explain every amount from source facts through determination policy to Ledger and statutory report lines.
Fail closed before a transaction is confirmed when required fiscal context or policy is missing.
invariants: Tax calculation never branches on a country literal inside the universal engine.
Every rate behavior mapping threshold and report rule is versioned and effective-dated.
The legal entity owns registration nexus and obligation while the branch contributes frozen origin and jurisdiction facts.
Every tax leg preserves policy and behavior provenance and maps to semantic Ledger roles rather than concrete accounts.
Historical tax results are immutable and corrections create governed fiscal and accounting events.
Missing mandatory jurisdiction nexus or published policy cannot silently produce zero tax.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Control Plane publishes Country Pack tax resources; Tax executes universal determination and calculation; source domains provide facts; Ledger posts semantic results; electronic fiscal documents render and transmit legal representations.

lessons.observedCapability: A configurable tax service with versioned features, applicability matrices, formulas, registrations and broad transaction integration.
lessons.lesson: The transaction payload and calculation policy must evolve independently through a governed lifecycle.
lessons.ubpDecision: Use one universal Tax contract and publish executable tax policy versions from Control Plane.

lessons.observedCapability: Explicit ordered determination for regime, place of supply, applicability, registration, status, rate, basis, calculation and recovery.
lessons.lesson: Complex legislation requires traceable stages, priorities and defaults instead of an opaque formula or flat dedup.
lessons.ubpDecision: Evolve UBP determination into an ordered policy graph with explainable stage results.

lessons.observedCapability: Fiscal positions automatically map taxes and accounts based on geography, partner and sequence.
lessons.lesson: Tax substitution and accounting mapping are two sides of the same fiscal decision.
lessons.ubpDecision: Publish first-class fiscal positions consumed by Tax and Ledger through semantic account roles.

lessons.observedCapability: Tax configuration API with audit logging and tenant-specific external tax provider routing.
lessons.lesson: External providers are valid adapters when policy ownership, tenant routing, credentials and audit remain explicit.
lessons.ubpDecision: Allow provider adapters behind a universal interface without moving country semantics or secrets into transaction domains.
